history.origins: Kan is a popular card game in Aomori prefecture in Japan, especially at Goshogawara and Tsugaru. Yonin-Kan is the four-player variant, also called Damari-Kan (silent kan) because the Joker holder and Jack-of-trumps holder form a secret partnership and do not announce themselves until those cards are played.
timeline: 20th century: Popular in Aomori prefecture (Goshogawara, Tsugaru).
